questions.prompt: Which of these built-in types is immutable?
questions.explanation: Tuples cannot be modified after creation; lists, dicts and sets can.

questions.prompt: Given def f(x, acc=[]): acc.append(x); return acc, what do f(1) and then f(2) return?
options: An error on the second call
questions.explanation: The default list is created once when the function is defined, so it is shared across calls.

questions.prompt: Which statement about the GIL in CPython is correct?
options: It allows threads to run Python bytecode in parallel on multiple cores
It lets only one thread execute Python bytecode at a time within a process
It is released only when the program exits
It makes every compound operation atomic
questions.explanation: The GIL serialises bytecode execution, which limits CPU-bound threading. It does not make compound operations atomic.
